title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $70.01 on the Dreame L40s Ultra AE
excerpt: This robot vacuum and mop won't be on sale for much longer.
content_html:
SAVE OVER $70: As of Aug. 7, the Dreame L40s Ultra AE robot vacuum and mop is on sale for $599.98 at Amazon for a limited time. Act fast to save $70.01 before the deal is done.

Credit: Dreame

$599.98 at Amazon
$669.99 Save $70.01

Recently, the FCC announced it's banning all robot vacuums made outside the U.S. However, the ban doesn't include models that are already in circulation, which is good news if you've been hoping to buy one.

If you're searching for a good deal, Amazon is the place to look. As of Aug. 7, the retailer has dropped a discount on the Dreame L40s Ultra AE robot vacuum and mop, but not for much longer. For a limited time, shoppers can snag the Dreame L40s Ultra AE for $599.98 rather than its full price of $669.99. Overall, you're saving $70.01 with this offer, but you only have Aug. 7 to buy at this low price.

Mashable Trend Report

Released last year, the Dreame L40s Ultra AE features 19,000Pa suction that can help free your carpets and rugs of dirt, crumbs, and hair. It even comes with a TriCut brush that helps prevent tangling, and a liftable rubber brush that can pick up larger debris from the floor. When it comes to mopping harder surfaces, it also features MopExtend technology, which extends the mopping pad to clean along edges or under furniture. And on top of that, it has AI-powered 3D obstacle-avoidance technology to help it steer clear of obstacles.

Its PowerDock Base is quite impressive, too. According to the store page, it automatically dispenses dust for up to 100 days and washes mops with hot water at 149 degrees Fahrenheit. It even offers hot-air drying to keep everything feeling fresh and clean the next time it goes out.

The clock is ticking to jump on this deal. Act fast to save on the Dreame L40s Ultra AE robot vacuum and mop at Amazon.

可混搭趋势报告

去年发布的 Dreame L40s Ultra AE 具有 19,000Pa 吸力，可帮助清除地毯上的污垢、碎屑和毛发。 它甚至还配备了一个 TriCut 刷子，有助于防止缠结，以及一个可抬起的橡胶刷，可以从地板上拾取较大的碎片。 当谈到拖地较硬的表面时，它还采用了 MopExtend 技术，可扩展拖地垫以沿边缘或家具下方进行清洁。 最重要的是，它还拥有人工智能驱动的3D避障技术，可以帮助它避开障碍物。

它的 PowerDock 底座也令人印象深刻。 根据商店页面介绍，它可以自动除尘长达 100 天，并用 149 华氏度的热水清洗拖把。 它甚至提供热风干燥功能，让下次外出时保持一切清新干净。
